full_text_zh:
[P1] 神奇糖果店
文/图：〔日〕宫西达也  翻译：朱自强
河北出版传媒集团
河北教育出版社

[P2] 神奇糖果店
有一天，小猪在森林里，
噔噔噔地走着、走着，
看见了一家神奇糖果店。
“狗獾叔叔，
神奇糖果是什么样的糖果啊？”

[P3] “这里的糖果，
含在嘴里就会发生神奇的事情。
来，这颗黄色的糖果，你试试看。”
“真……真的吗？”

[P4] 嗖
小猪一边含着糖果，一边说：
“叔叔，这哪是神奇糖果啊！”
狗獾叔叔微笑着说：
“这块岩石，你来举举看。”
“嗯，好甜啊。”
可是，什么神奇的事儿也没发生。
“不……不可能，这么大的岩石……”
小猪一边说，一边去搬。

[P5] 结果，小猪轻松地举了起来。
“哇！真……真厉害啊！
真的是神奇糖果啊。”
“没骗你吧？是很神奇吧？
这一颗是大力士糖果啊。”

[P6] 可是，小猪吃完糖果，再去搬岩石——
“哎哎哎……”
小猪脸都憋红了，岩石却纹丝不动。
“糖果一吃完，功效就没了。
小猪，接下来这颗蓝糖果，
可真是不得了啊！”

说着，狗獾叔叔把糖果放进小猪嘴里。

可是，小猪含了糖果，什么事也没发生。
狗獾叔叔就说：
“小猪，你大声喊喊看。”
就在小猪打算大声呼呼时——

[P7] “含了这颗糖果，
就能发出狮子的吼声。”
“嗷，嗷嗷——真厉害！”
小猪很吃惊。

不过，小猪吃光了糖果之后，
“哼，哼，哼——”
发出的仍然是以前的哼哼声。

“小猪，接下来这颗绿糖果，可真是厉害啊！”
说着，狗獾叔叔把糖果放进小猪嘴里。
结果——

[P8] 小猪竟然一点儿一点儿地消失了。
“原来吃了它，能隐身啊。
真厉害！真厉害！”
小猪高兴坏了。

在哪儿呢？

不过，一吃光糖果，小猪又变回来了。
“小猪，下一颗糖果才真叫厉害呢。”

狗獾叔叔把一颗红糖果放进小猪嘴里。

[P9] 这一次，小猪竟……竟然变成了大灰狼。
“怎么样，这颗糖果厉害吧？”
“真厉害啊！叔叔，请给我三颗红糖果，一颗绿糖果。”
狗獾叔叔把糖果放进瓶子里。

“这颗糖果白送你了。你遇到了困难，
一含着它，就会发生让人吃惊的事情。”
说着，狗獾叔叔把白糖果也放了进去。

“狗獾叔叔，谢谢您。”
小猪道了谢，笑眯眯地走了。
“好嘞，来一场恶作剧吧。”
小猪把三颗红糖果
一下子塞进嘴里。

[P10] 小猪变成了大灰狼，
跑去吓唬大家。
“嘿嘿嘿……我是大灰狼！”
“嘿嘿嘿……我要吃了你们！”
“吓死人了！大灰狼来了！”
“救命啊！”
大家边喊边逃。

“嘿嘿嘿……他们没有认出我，
以为我真是大灰狼。”
就在这时——

[P11] “不行，不行，太差劲儿了！
像你这样，别说兔子，
连老鼠都抓不住！”
一只真的大灰狼
从树后跳了出来。

小猪不由自主地说道：
“那……那该怎么做啊？”

“跟我来，我教你。”
大灰狼根本没有察觉，
这只狼是小猪变的。

“请……请多关照。”
小猪嘴上这样说着，
身体却吓得发抖，想赶快逃跑。
而他随后被带到的地方，竟然是——

[P12] 大灰狼镇！到处都是大灰狼。
“好像有小猪的气味！”
“是吃起来很香的那种气味。”
“是从这儿发出来的，从这儿……”
大灰狼们不断地向小猪围拢过来。
就在这时——

[P13] 哎呀呀，
小猪的尾巴变回来了。
“喂，这家伙好奇怪啊！”
“这家伙有一股小猪的气味。”
“真可疑……”

[P14] 不只是尾巴，
小猪的手、脚和身体都变了回来。
“不好！”
小猪急忙把绿糖果塞进嘴里。
于是——

[P15] 小猪的身体变得透明，
大灰狼们看不见他了。
“嘿嘿嘿，趁这工夫赶快逃吧。”
可是——

[P16] 因为气味，小猪被发现了。
接着，嘴里的糖果化光以后，
小猪变回了原来的样子。
“嘿嘿嘿，抓住他了。”
小猪心想：“这下完了！”
他想起狗獾叔叔说的话：
含上白糖果，就会发生让人吃惊的事情。
于是他把白糖果放进嘴里。
结果——

[P17] 呜哇——
小猪的身体
竟然噌噌噌地变大了！

[P18] “救命啊！”
大灰狼们大喊着，
从小猪的胯下逃走了。

小猪放下心来，说道：
“这糖果真的很神奇，很厉害……
不过，还是普通的糖果好啊。”
说完，就嘿嘿嘿地笑了起来。
full_text_en:
[P1] The Magic Candy Store
Text and Illustrations: [Japan] Tatsuya Miura  Translator: Zhu Ziqiang
Hebei Publishing and Media Group
Hebei Education Press

[P2] Magic Candy Shop
One day, the little pig was walking in the forest,
TAP TAP TAP, walking and walking,
and saw a magic candy shop.
"Uncle Badger,
what kind of candy is magic candy?"

[P3] "The candies here,
if you put them in your mouth, will cause magical things to happen.
Come on, try this yellow candy."
"Really... really?"

[P4] Whoosh
Piggy, while sucking on the candy, said:
"Uncle, this isn't a magical candy at all!"
Mr. Badger smiled and said:
"This rock, try lifting it."
"Mmm, so sweet."
But nothing magical happened.
"No... impossible, such a big rock..."
Piggy said, while trying to move it.

[P5] As a result, the little pig lifted it easily.
"Wow! Really... amazing!
It's really a magical candy."
"Didn't I trick you? It's really magical, right?
This one is the Super Strength Candy."

[P6] But after the little pig finished the candy and tried to move the rock—
"Ah-ah-ah..."
His face turned red, but the rock didn't budge.
"Once the candy is gone, the power disappears.
Little pig, this next blue candy—
well, it's something special!"

Saying that, Uncle Badger put the candy into the little pig's mouth.

But after the little pig held the candy in his mouth, nothing happened.
Uncle Badger said:
"Little pig, shout out loud!"
Just as the little pig was about to shout—

[P7] "If you hold this candy in your mouth, you can roar like a lion."
"Roar, roar—so amazing!" 
The little pig was very surprised.

However, after the little pig finished the candy,
"Hmph, hmph, hmph—"
he still made the same old piggy sounds.

"Little pig, next up is this green candy—it's really amazing!"
Saying that, Uncle Badger put the candy into the little pig's mouth.
And then—

[P8] The little pig disappeared bit by bit.
"So this makes you invisible! Wow! Wow!"
The little pig was overjoyed.

Where is he?

But as soon as he finished the candy, the little pig reappeared.
"Little pig, the next candy is truly amazing."

The badger uncle put a red candy into the little pig's mouth.

[P9] This time, the little pig... actually turned into a big gray wolf.
"How about that, is this candy powerful?"
"It's really powerful! Uncle, give me three red candies and one green candy."
The badger uncle put the candies into the bottle.

"This candy is a free gift for you. When you're in trouble,
just hold it in your mouth, and something surprising will happen."
Saying that, the badger uncle also put the white candy into the bottle.

"Thank you, Uncle Badger."
The little pig said thank you and walked away with a smile.
"Alright, let's play a prank."
The little pig stuffed three red candies
into his mouth all at once.

[P10] The little pig turned into a big gray wolf,
and ran off to scare everyone.
"Hehehe... I'm the big gray wolf!"
"Hehehe... I'm going to eat you!"
"Oh no! The big gray wolf is coming!"
"Help!"
Everyone screamed and ran away.

"Hehehe... They didn't recognize me,
they thought I was really the big gray wolf."
Just then —

[P11] "No, no, you're terrible!
With you like this, you can't even catch a rabbit,
let alone a mouse!"
A real big gray wolf
jumped out from behind the tree.

The little pig said involuntarily:
"Well... what should I do?"

"Come with me, I'll teach you."
The big gray wolf didn't notice at all,
this wolf was actually the little pig transformed.

"Please... please take care of me."
The little pig said that, but
his body trembled with fear, wanting to run away quickly.
And the place he was then taken to was ——

[P12] Wolf Town! Everywhere are wolves.
"It smells like pig!"
"The kind that smells delicious!"
"It's coming from here, from here..."
The wolves keep closing in on the pig.
Just then —

[P13] Oh my,
the pig's tail has changed back.
"Hey, this guy is really strange!"
"This guy smells like a pig."
"Really suspicious..."

[P14] Not just the tail,
the pig's hands, feet, and body changed back.
"Oh no!"
The pig hurriedly stuffed the green candy into his mouth.
Then —

[P15] Piglet's body became transparent,
the big gray wolves couldn't see him.
"Hehehe, now's the time to run away quickly."
But ——

[P16] Because of the smell, the little pig was discovered.
Then, after the candy in his mouth melted away,
the little pig turned back to his original form.
"Hehehe, we've got him!"
The little pig thought: "This is it!"
He remembered what Uncle Badger had said:
Put the white candy in your mouth, and something surprising will happen.
So he put the white candy in his mouth.
The result —

[P17] Wow——
Little Pig's body
was suddenly growing bigger and bigger!

[P18] "Help!"
The big gray wolves shouted,
and fled from under the little pig's legs.

The little pig relaxed and said:
"This candy is really magical and powerful...
But still, ordinary candy is better."
Then he laughed, "Hee-hee-hee!"
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《神奇糖果店》的封面，展示了主角小猪手持糖果瓶的卡通形象，背景是树林，上方有书名、作者和出版社信息。
[P2] 小猪在森林里散步时，发现了一家名为“神奇糖果店”的店铺，并好奇地向店里的狗獾叔叔询问神奇糖果是什么样的糖果。
[P3] 狗獾叔叔向小猪介绍神奇糖果，并递给他一颗黄色的糖果，小猪表示怀疑。
[P4] 小猪吃了神奇糖果后觉得甜，但未见神奇效果，狗獾叔叔让他尝试举起一块大岩石，小猪表示怀疑并准备去搬。
[P5] 小猪吃下神奇糖果后，轻松举起了大岩石，狗獾叔叔确认这是大力士糖果，小猪对此感到惊讶和赞叹。
[P6] 小猪吃完第一颗神奇糖果后无法搬动岩石，狗獾叔叔递给他第二颗蓝色糖果，并让他大声喊叫以测试效果。
[P7] 小猪吃了能发出狮子吼声的糖果，起初成功发出吼声，但吃完后声音恢复原样。狗獾叔叔随后给他一颗绿色糖果，准备测试新效果。
[P8] 小猪吃了能隐身的糖果后消失，随后又变回来，狗獾叔叔接着给他一颗红色的糖果准备测试新效果。
[P9] 小猪在神奇糖果店吃下糖果后变成了大灰狼，狗獾叔叔将白糖果赠予他并说明其用途。小猪道谢后离开，准备用三颗红糖果恶作剧。
[P10] 小猪吃下神奇糖果后变成大灰狼，在森林里吓唬其他小动物，大家惊慌逃跑，小猪暗自得意，但就在那时，故事迎来转折。
[P11] 小猪变成大灰狼后吓唬森林里的动物，一只真正的狼出现并批评他，小猪感到慌张，被带到一个未知的地方。
[P12] 小猪变成大灰狼后，发现自己身处一个全是狼的小镇，狼群闻到他身上小猪的气味，正围拢过来，故事即将迎来新的转折。
[P13] 小猪变成大灰狼后，尾巴变回原样，被狼群发现身上有小猪气味，引起狼群怀疑和围拢。
[P14] 小猪变成大灰狼后，身体开始变回原样，他惊慌地吃下绿糖果试图恢复，周围狼群围拢过来，场面紧张。
[P15] 小猪吃下隐身糖果后身体变得透明，大灰狼们看不见他，他准备趁机逃跑，但画面暗示情况即将发生变化。
[P16] 小猪因气味被狼群发现，糖果化光后变回原样，狼群围住他。他想起狗獾叔叔的话，吃下白糖果，画面定格在‘结果——’，暗示即将发生新变化。
[P17] 小猪的身体突然变大，他发出惊喜的叫声，周围的小动物们惊慌地四散逃跑。
[P18] 小猪变成大灰狼后吓跑了真正的狼群，他放下心来，感叹糖果神奇但觉得普通糖果更好，开心地笑了。
[P19] 页面为绘本末尾的版权页，中央绘有一只獾站在柜台后，面前摆放着多个装有彩色糖果的玻璃罐，上方有出版社和绿色印刷产品标识，右下角有ISBN条形码及定价信息。
